summary: CLAIM C-0002: Transport of materials to the site by water is well-established; the builders used a network of Nile waterways, boats, and the lost Ahramat branch.
content: Established consensus: materials reached Giza by boat via the Nile and an artificial canal/basin system, with the Merer logbooks documenting Tura limestone shipments (EV-0007, EV-0008) and the 2024 mapping of the Ahramat Nile branch (EV-0009) plus the excavated 'Lake of Khufu' basins (EV-0010). This answers the transport-to-site question, though the final land-based and vertical lifting method remains unknown (see C-0001).
